lines.zh: 我在原生池里慢吞吞地挪。
lines.en: I shuffle slowly through the primal pools.

lines.zh: 卤水托着我，走得不费劲。
lines.en: The brine carries me; walking is easy.
My shell grates the pool floor.
I patrol a stretch of the brine shore.

lines.zh: 潜影贝的祖先，走路也慢。
lines.en: Ancestor of shulkers, slow afoot too.
A skin of salt floats on the water.
I haul a bubble of brine along.
I crack rock salt along the bank.
I turn sideways for my shell to fit.

lines.zh: 我拖着卤水泡挪向池心。
lines.en: I drag my brine bubble toward the middle of the pool.
My brine bubble sways with me.

lines.zh: 我的步子留下浅浅的盐痕。
lines.en: My steps leave pale salt marks.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，只露一条缝。
lines.en: I pull in, leaving only a slit.
The brine bubble wraps me. Warm.
Salt crusts white over my shell.

lines.zh: 我的祖先意识在慢慢转。
lines.en: My ancestral mind turns slowly.
The pool stirs and I know it.
Shell shut, not even light gets in.
I wait for someone to step in the brine.
This pool has not changed in ages.
I count the salt crystals on the surface.
Inside my shell, echoes sound closer.
I need no sleep, only stillness.

lines.zh: 潜影贝会学我，只是学不像。
lines.en: Shulkers imitate me, but poorly.
You stepped in brine. Your feet will numb.
My shell faces you. Keep off.
You carry no smell of salt.

lines.zh: 原生池不欢迎干的生物。
lines.en: The primal pool dislikes dry things.

lines.zh: 我抬起壳缝，看了你一眼。
lines.en: I lift my shell's slit and glance at you.

lines.zh: 你要找的末地塔在那边。
lines.en: The tower you want is that way.

lines.zh: 我的祖先见过更多闯者。
lines.en: My ancestors saw far more intruders.
Do not tap my shell with that sword.

lines.zh: 卤水会让你变慢，你信吗？
lines.en: Brine will slow you. Believe it?

lines.zh: 我的卤水泡把你的倒影泡皱了。
lines.en: My brine bubble wrinkles your reflection.
The rock salt in your hand is mine.
Stand on the bank. Stay out of the pool.
I am moving now. Slowly.
Back on the bank, and I stay quiet.

lines.zh: 我的壳缝里渗出一线盐水。
lines.en: A thread of brine seeps from the seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 我缩紧，卤水从缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I clamp shut; brine squeezes out.
A tendril snapped. It regrows.
The salt crust fell. Soft beneath.
I wobble; half my bubble pops.
It hurts, and I slow further.
I knock a dent into the pool floor.
My blood is the color of brine.
My shell will not close. I endure.
That flipped me backward.
Salt crystal? That I do want.

lines.zh: 你举的鱼，不是我的食物。
lines.en: That fish is not my food.
I lick brine. I do not eat bread.
Set the salt down and you may go.
Too weak. Tastes like plain water.
The salt in your hand is not salty enough.
My ancestors came for salt.
Do not shake it. The salt will spill.
This pinch will last me half a day.
My brine bubble smells better than your gift.
My shell hits you like a small boat.
Do not step on the pool floor. I am there.

lines.zh: 我的壳棱刮过你的小腿。
lines.en: The ridge of my shell scraped your calf.
The salt skin broke. I am wet.
One bump and brine splashes you.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的壳才转得动。
lines.en: Move back so my shell can turn.
My shell or your boot? Which holds?

lines.zh: 碰撞让池边的盐塌了一块。
lines.en: The bump collapses a chunk of salt.
I do not shove. I slowly squeeze.
I nudge you back half a step.

lines.zh: 潜影贝的祖先，卵产在池底。
lines.en: Shulker ancestors lay eggs on the pool floor.

lines.zh: 我的壳会一代代厚下去。
lines.en: My shell thickens with each generation.
Ask me when the brine rises.
Many eggs already rest on the floor.
We do not court. We wait for salt season.
You ask too directly, living one.
My young grow their arms inside the shell.
Only thick brine makes a pair.

lines.zh: 我的祖辈也是这样过来的。
lines.en: My forebears did the same.

lines.zh: 别说出去，这是我族的事。
lines.en: Say nothing of this. It is ours.
This rock salt goes into my shell.
Your arrow soaks in the brine.
I curl a tendril around a tooth.
What lies on the floor belongs to the pool.
I tuck it under my shell and carry it.

lines.zh: 黏液留下黏糊糊的痕迹。
lines.en: Slime leaves a sticky trail.
This shell shard is familiar.
I keep it. It may trade for salt.
Picking things up is old business.
Do not grab. I am slow but first.
You stepped in the pool. Locked.
My brine bubble begins to swell.
My shell slit aims at you.
The ancestral mind says: slow him.
No salt on you. Perfect.
I ready a sticky glob.
Target on the bank. That will do.

lines.zh: 这一发的轨迹我算好了。
lines.en: I have the arc worked out.

lines.zh: 你听见池底的咕嘟声了吗？
lines.en: Hear that gurgle from the floor?

lines.zh: 潜影贝的老祖宗要动手。
lines.en: The shulker's forebear attacks.
Brine wraps me as I sink.

lines.zh: 盐雾起来，你就看不见了。
lines.en: Salt mist rises. You will lose sight.
I turn my shell toward you, slowly.
The brine rises at your feet.
You are walking heavier, are you not?
No hurry. The pool is mine.
Closer and the glob flies.
My slit stays on you.
You turn. So do I.
Salt mist circles the pool's edge.
I count your steps. They slow.

lines.zh: 这条池岸没有第二条路。
lines.en: There is no second path along this bank.
I soak in brine and wait for you.

lines.zh: 我沿着池底横移，跟着你。
lines.en: I slide along the floor, tracking you.

lines.zh: 壳缝里那点光，一直对着你。
lines.en: The faint light in my slit stays on you.
The sticky glob splats your leg.
One hit and your steps drag.
My tendril snaps out and cuts.
My shell's rim cracks your knee.
Brine splashes into your wound.
I strike not to kill, but to slow.
You are pinned. Try moving.
Salt grains wedge into your armor's seams.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，然后缩回壳里。
lines.en: I ram, then pull back in.
This time, you are the slow one.

lines.zh: 黏住了，你走三步掉一步。
lines.en: Stuck. Every three steps, one is lost.
The ancestor hits lightly, but often.
A string of bubbles rises from the floor.
In the brine, a shell floats up.
The primal pool has a guard again.
The salt skin breaks; I poke out.
One splash and I am here.
My shell opens and the brine shifts.

lines.zh: 祖先的记忆让我浮上来。
lines.en: Ancestral memory lifts me up.
The water clouds. That means me.
I push up from under the salt layer.
By the rock salt, I settle in.
This stretch of water is mine.

lines.zh: 咕嘟声从深处理到浅处。
lines.en: The gurgle travels from deep to shallow.
My shell shuts; the surface calms.

lines.zh: 火把盐烤干，我的壳发脆。
lines.en: Fire dries the salt; my shell turns brittle.

lines.zh: 我从池边滚下去，壳磕裂了。
lines.en: I roll off the bank and crack my shell.

lines.zh: 卤水太深，我的泡也撑不住。
lines.en: The brine runs deep; even my bubble fails.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到岸上，干了。
lines.en: The blast throws me ashore, drying out.
An arrow pierces my shell and sticks.
Magic pries my shell open.

lines.zh: 没有盐，我的壳一天天变薄。
lines.en: Without salt, my shell thins by the day.
Lightning boils the pool around me.

lines.zh: 池底漏进虚空，我被往下拉。
lines.en: The void leaks through the floor and pulls me.
